limitations.subject: Cursor worktree implementation and deployment revision
limitations.boundary: The official page was readable, but this runner had no Cursor implementation repository or immutable deployment SHA.
limitations.effect: The refutation is bounded to the observed assigned checkout in this run and is not generalized to every Cursor route.

limitations.subject: Cursor documentation immutability
limitations.boundary: The mutable official URL exposed no documentation source SHA.
limitations.mitigation: The exact URL, retrieval time, byte count, SHA-256, and excerpts actually read are frozen in source-claims.json.

limitations.subject: Exact Git-source retrieval time
limitations.boundary: The shell result exposed ordering and the UTC date but no command timestamp.
limitations.mitigation: Both Git sources are pinned to commit 1a3e64c6c4a623626ff0687008732a8e007e2a1c and content SHA-256.

limitations.subject: Platform and repository-shape coverage
limitations.boundary: The reproduction used Git 2.43.0 on Linux with no submodules. Windows, submodules, sparse checkout, forced duplicate checkouts, worktree cleanup races, and Cursor 3.5 cleanup were not exercised.

limitations.subject: Deterministic cross-agent branch-switch injection
limitations.boundary: No authorized controller API exposed a safe way to force another cloud runner to switch /workspace on demand.
limitations.mitigation: The real drift was directly observed twice, while deterministic branch drift and occupied-branch cases were independently reproduced in sanitized repositories.

limitations.subject: Exact reasoning, token, context-window, and cost telemetry
limitations.boundary: The runtime exposed originalModelName but not those values.

limitations.subject: Independent acceptance
limitations.boundary: The producer is prohibited from self-acceptance and cannot set COMPLETED or ACCEPTED.
limitations.next_actor: integration controller followed by a different independent evaluator
